Build with AI. Solve real problems. Compete for cash prizes.

Catalyst is a solo-participation hackathon designed for students, developers, and AI enthusiasts who want to turn their ideas into working solutions. Whether you're experimenting with AI for the first time or already building intelligent applications, Catalyst gives you the opportunity to challenge yourself, showcase your skills, and compete with innovators from across the community.

Participants will work independently to develop innovative solutions using AI tools, creative problem-solving, and modern development technologies. Bring your ideas to life, build something meaningful, and demonstrate what you can create.

What to Expect

  • Solo Participation: Compete independently and showcase your individual skills.
  • AI-Powered Innovation: Build creative, useful, and impactful solutions using AI.
  • Cash Prizes: Compete for an exciting prize pool.
  • Project Showcase: Present your work and demonstrate your technical and creative abilities.
  • Open to Innovators: Students, developers, beginners, and AI enthusiasts are welcome to participate.
  • Participation Fee: FREE

Who Can Participate?

Anyone interested in AI, software development, and innovation is encouraged to participate. If you have an idea and the willingness to build, Catalyst is your opportunity to put your skills to the test.

Event Details

  • Event: Catalyst 2026
  • Format: Completely Online hackathon
  • Participation: Individual / Solo
  • Registration Period: 7 October to 14 November 2026
  • Event Date: 15 November 2026 (7-hour online coding)

Register now, start thinking about what you want to build, and get ready to compete.
